selection.rule: Review threads on the 1000 newest PRs by creation (#6110 to #7380, read 2026-11-15) whose first comment came from a third-party bot (Devin, Cursor Bugbot, CodeRabbit, Copilot reviewer, Semgrep). Admitted when the author's reply cites a fix commit that resolves locally, touches the thread's path, and descends from the reviewed commit. Split: heldout when PR >= 7066. defect_class, theme, context_needed, mechanical and summary are model-drafted (Sonnet, one pass) and not hand-audited unless noted.

Bare skills/... pointer resolves against the consumer repository, not the vendored plugin, so the protocol cannot be loaded; it needs plugin-root variables.
Agent template pointer assumes cwd is the plugin root, but Claude Code runs from the consumer repository, so the protocol cannot load.

Protocol claims not to restate code-review-norms yet duplicates all four prefix mappings, creating two authorities that can drift.

Handoff text treats check_pr_round_cap.py as a read-only counter, but each active call advances the round and persists a marker.

Dependabot config sets no cooldown, so newly published, possibly malicious or unstable package versions are proposed immediately.
